rockrye.why: Cream soda with a cherry wink. Michiganders order it by name.

redpop.why: Strawberry pop. 'Redpop' is a word only Michiganders say.

moonmist.why: The citrus pop at every Michigan grad party.

rootbeer.why: The flavor people who left buy by the case.

vernors.why: What Mom poured when you were sick. Add vanilla ice cream for a Boston Cooler.

bbq.why: The sweet BBQ chip nobody outside Michigan gets right.

cherrybbq.n: Great Lakes Cherry BBQ Kettle Chips
cherrybbq.why: Michigan potatoes, dusted with Traverse City cherry.

kars.why: The trail mix in every Michigan glove box.

pistachios.why: Roasted in Eastern Market by America's oldest pistachio roaster.

hotfudge.why: The jar people ask for after they move away. Warm it and pour.

mfudge.why: The souvenir every trip to the Straits ended with.

cocherry.why: A Sleeping Bear Dunes day trip you can eat.

yooperbar.why: A chocolate bar shaped like the U.P. Instant Yooper pride.

drycherry.why: Michigan grows most of the country's tart cherries. These are the good ones.

spoon.why: Small-batch preserves from Petoskey, made with Michigan cherries.

koeze.why: Just peanuts and salt, in the jar Michiganders hoard.

trenary.why: The cinnamon rusk Yoopers dunk in their coffee. Keeps for months.

jampot.why: Thimbleberries barely grow anywhere but the U.P.'s north woods.

maple.why: Michigan is a top-five maple state. Up North sugarbush syrup.

jiffy.why: The little blue box in every Michigan pantry.

noodles.why: The noodles from the Frankenmuth chicken dinner.

beans.why: The Thumb grows more dry beans than anywhere in the country.

stone.why: Michigan's state stone. Everyone searched the beach for one.

bridge.why: Five miles of bridge, for the tree.

magnet.why: For the fridge of anyone who uses their hand as a map.

mug.why: All five lakes, around your morning coffee.

coffee.why: Roasted in Midtown. For dunking the Trenary Toast.

card.why: Your message, written by hand. Prices never go inside.
